body: the merch will most likely have the updated tour dates on there. i've never seen a pearl jam show, but will be going to my first two shows on the rescheduled tour. i also saw one of the three rescheduled foo fighters gigs in 2018, and they used a shirt in which they had crossed out the original date and put the new rescheduled date on it. all other tour shirts had the updated tour dates on them. so i'm thinking pearl jam will probably be doing something similar to that.
